# A Cutting from the Roots

*Godwin wants something green from the World Tree's own ground for his kingdom border. Look over the Tree's outermost root in the Rootlands, then thin out the Dark Stumps there.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Selsior](../towns/selsior_quests.md) |

## Objectives

1. Look at the Tree's outermost root in [The Rootlands](../maps/rootlands.md)
2. Defeat 20 [Dark Stump](../monsters/dark_stump.md)

## Rewards

- 1,250 EXP
- 300 mesos
- [Red Potion](../items/red_potion.md) x10
- +15 standing with Selsior
- +80 standing with [Godwin](../npcs/godwin.md)
